content:
Hi everyone, I wrote a claude-code based open source AI agent to automatically formalize a given pdf into Lean, whether its book or paper. The pipeline tries its best to maintain semantic equivalence between natural language statement and Lean statement. You are welcome to try it out!

Github link: https://github.com/chenyang-an/pdf_to_lean
Discussion thread at #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > PDF to Lean: Agent to formalize Lean given book/paper pdf.
